styles.description: Default — no stylistic modification. Matches today's pipeline behavior exactly. Safe to use with every model.
Editorial luxury campaign — slow-shutter panning, COS/A.P.C. voice, literary interior narration around the product.
Single tungsten source, Rembrandt falloff, archival cinema stillness for low-key magazine editorial.
Direct on-camera flash, wet urban sidewalk, caught between one thing and the next — Daido/Moriyama documentary register.
SX-70 instant film style — warm whites, soft light leaks, quiet morning intimacy.
Warm desaturated domestic stillness — soft window light, knit and walnut textures, unhurried gifting.
Bare hard flash on warm-white seamless — frontal stare, sunglasses as a wall, hard body-shadow cast onto the paper.
User-generated content — mirror selfie, friend snapshot, careless iPhone POV for authentic social-media-native imagery.
90s skate magazine — pushed 35mm, heavy grain, low angle, raw street documentary energy.
Early-2000s digital camera with harsh super-flash, nostalgic bedroom backdrop. Y2K Tumblr aesthetic.
